notes: «أبی ره»: the blessing «ره» is not part of the surface; «أبی» is the compiler's father, a relation (rule 7)
«يَرْفَعُهُ إِلَی» is an unnamed gap (rule 8) before هشام بن سالم
«قُلْتُ لِأَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع» names the Imam in the words after the chain: the last link, kind imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); «ع» is a blessing
